Spring.name: Spring Awakening
Spring.tagline: Tender shoots, crisp radishes, sweet early strawberries, and aromatic herbs.
Spring.chefTip: Toss delicate spring greens with a simple emulsion of raw wildflower honey, lemon juice, and cold-pressed olive oil.
Spring.ecoFact: Buying spring greens in season reduces greenhouse gas heating emissions from out-of-season commercial greenhouses by up to 70%.

Summer.name: Summer Sun & Harvest
Summer.tagline: Peak juicy heirloom tomatoes, sweet berries, stone fruits, and sweet corn.
Summer.chefTip: Slice heirloom tomatoes thickly, sprinkle with coarse sea salt, tear fresh Genovese basil leaves, and layer with fresh artisanal goat chèvre.
Summer.ecoFact: Summer outdoor sun-grown field tomatoes have a 90% lower carbon footprint than winter greenhouse imports.

Autumn.name: Autumn Abundance
Autumn.tagline: Crisp orchard apples, sweet root vegetables, hardy squashes, and earthy gourmet mushrooms.
Autumn.chefTip: Roast rainbow carrots and Lion's Mane mushrooms with fresh rosemary and a drizzle of raw honey until caramelized.
Autumn.ecoFact: Orchards act as natural carbon sinks, absorbing tonnes of atmospheric CO2 each year during their peak fruiting cycle.

Winter.name: Winter Earth & Citrus
Winter.tagline: Frost-kissed sweet Tuscan kale, vibrant Meyer lemons, hearty root crops, and farmstead cheeses.
Winter.chefTip: Massage Lacinato kale with Meyer lemon juice and sea salt for 2 minutes to break down fibers, then toss with shaved hard goat cheese.
Winter.ecoFact: Winter farmers markets support multi-generational farming families during lean off-peak seasons.
